name: hyper-realistic-closet-selfie
image_purpose: fashion lifestyle post and pet-friendly closet reference

prompt.project_info: Hyper-realistic 4:5 mirror selfie using the attached approved-adult face reference.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman preserving the attached face and identity, brown hair with burgundy front highlights in a low bun, playful pout, white manicure, gold hoops and rings; wearing a fitted black spaghetti-strap mini dress with square neckline and short hem, holding a tan smartphone with a small panda photo tucked into the case.
prompt.composition_elements: Kneeling on light wood floor in a luxury walk-in closet, small merle dog with red/pink collar standing beside her, full-length mirror, folded clothes, hanging garments, white shelving and Sephora/Mango shopping bags.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright soft-diffused indoor lighting, neutral beige, wood and white palette, sharp realistic textures and friendly pet interaction.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 4:5, eye-level mirror composition, 4K photorealism, accurate reflection, natural skin, fabric and fur detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic vertical 4:5 walk-in-closet mirror selfie of the approved adult woman from the attached face reference, preserving face and identity, with brown hair and burgundy front highlights in a low bun, playful pout, white manicure, gold hoops and rings, wearing a fitted black spaghetti-strap mini dress with square neckline and short hem, holding a tan smartphone with a small panda photo tucked into its case, kneeling on a light wood floor beside a small merle dog with red collar, luxury closet with full-length mirror, folded clothes, hanging garments, white shelving and shopping bags, bright soft indoor lighting, realistic fur and fabric, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, transparent clothing, exposed breasts, exposed genitals, child, minor, identity drift, unsafe animal handling, distorted anatomy, bad hands, plastic skin, watermark, text, logo

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the person reference as required. Preserve face, identity, outfit, dog, closet, mirror, shopping bags and lighting; keep the dog calm and safely beside the subject.
